description_full:
PT Anabatic Technologies Tbk is opening new career opportunities for individuals who are ready to contribute their skills and experience across different areas of our business.

We are currently looking for candidates to fill the following positions:

-Admin Warehouse Officer
-Accounting Officer
-Investor Relations
-Learning Development & Engagement Internship

Whether you have professional experience or are looking to gain your first internship experience, we invite you to take a closer look at these opportunities. Swipe left to explore the qualifications and responsibilities for each position!

📩 For full time positions, visit https://www.anabatic.com/career/ to find out more and submit your application.

📩 For the internship position, send your CV to recruitmentaticholding@anabatic.com.

We look forward to receiving your applications!
